findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment:
The following canned foods in the dry storage area were observed to have dents:
1. Canned peaches (significant dent in body)
2. Canned mandarin oranges (significant dent in body)
3. Canned beans (dent along the seam)

CORRECTED - The person-in-charge was informed and the dented cans were removed from the shelf. Dented cans can have the entry and harborage of Botulism, ensure canned foods with dents are removed from the shelf and not served in meals to the children.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [PF]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The 3 part sink needs to be re-caulked, the caulk present is peeling away and missing in some places.  Ensure this is re-caulked to prevent moisture and food debris accumulation.  All areas of the cafeteria shall be smooth and easily cleanable.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only. 

Observed employee use the three compartment sink to wash hands. Education provided. Ensure staff use a dedicated hand washing sink only to wash hands. Ensure staff do not “rinse” hands in between tasks. A complete hand washing step must occur between tasks or if hands become soiled or contaminated. COS.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.
Germ-X hand sanitizer found near hand sink.
Germ-X was removed.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
At start of inspection, three-pan sink quat sanitizer tested at 0 - 100ppm.  Staff states that sanitizer ran out and in resupplying it, she forgot to finish adding more.  IMMEDIATELY CORRECTED - More sanitizer was added and concentration was then greater than 400ppm.  Eventually sanitizer was adjusted until it reached 200ppm (as directed on bottle).  Make sure to test sanitizer every day, with accurate test strips, as too little concentration will not sanitize and too strong will be toxic.
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
In Storage Room w/ hand washing sink, some mixing bowls and equipment are stored facing up, without a cover.  Make sure to store clean equipment so food-contact surface is protected from contamination at all times.
750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash,        dust and other means.               750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) (R) Plastic cart in store room (freezer room) has a severe crack on the top compartment and a gap at the bottom by one of the wheels. Repair (seal the crack/gap with caulk) or replace the cart. B) Lower ledge of green milk cart has chipped/peeling paint. Repaint the lower ledge of the green milk cart. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.citation_text: 750.1170 - (x2) A) Screen door in kitchen has gaps at the bottom at both corners where light is visible. B) Outer doors to All Purpose Room adjacent to kitchen were open upon arrival of inspector. Doors were closed by inspector, gaps were observed. The single door has significant gaps all along the bottom and sides where the sweep and weather stripping are damaged/missing. The double doors have a gap at the lower left corner  and a few spots along the bottom where the sweep is damaged. Repair the above doors so they are tight fitting & vermin proof. Keep doors in adjacent room closed at all times. Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects. (see general comments)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.citation_text: 750.690 - A) Plastic cart in store room has severe crack on the top compartment and a gap at the bottom by one of the wheels. Repair (seal cracks/gap with caulk) or replace the cart. B) Bottom inside metal cabinet has loose contact paper and the shelf is rusty. Remove the contact paper; resurface the bottom inside the metal cabinet. C) Lower shelves in storage rooms are in direct contact with the floors. Raise the lower shelves to be at least 6 inches off the ground to allow for proper cleaning of floors under the shelving units. Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and cleanable, free from cracks/crevices, and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.comment: 750.800b - Fan blowing toward food prep area had dust buildup on it. Clean the fan as needed to eliminate buildup of dust/debris and prevent potential cross contamination of foods.
